`words` (default): every word with its index, times and flags. `text`: every word with its index as plain text, one sentence per line starting with its start time, about a seventh of the size, for reading a whole long clip (finding retakes, repeats or where something is said). `sentences`: one row per sentence (first and last word index, start and end time, text), about a quarter of the size.
